budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Physically carry both evacuees from the east rooms to the shelter at (1,3) before all rescuers are disabled or tick 128.
task.natural_termination: Both evacuees rescued, or every rescuer has zero health; natural completion has priority over timeout on the same tick.
task.interaction: Lantern and beacon illumination changes other roles visibility and the cells a loaded carrier can enter. Shared battery stock, exclusive bulky carrying, object competition, relay timing and moving dark hazards create action-dependent coordination.
task.observation_access: Each role sees its own status and public time/rescue totals. Current cell visibility uses a 17-sample rounded cell ray and Manhattan distance: radius one regardless of light, or radius four in illuminated cells. Shadows additionally require illumination. No other map cells, shadow phase, distant inventories or unseen object positions enter the role observation. Renderer uses the same visibility arrays.
task.transition_order: Movement uses pre-step illumination; rotating object interactions follow; charge/relay timers tick; shadows move every third tick; new light determines damage; rescue and terminal state are then evaluated.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Number of evacuees delivered to the shelter; public cumulative record
Evacuees newly rescued on this transition

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
